All senses are included, most common first, and a lemma takes its synonyms from the first part of speech that has it so verb and noun meanings do not mix. Kept: single alphabetic lemmas of three or more letters that appear in WordNet's semantically tagged corpora, which filters out the rare and archaic tail. Up to 20 synonyms per lemma, taken from the synsets that lemma belongs to. Loaded as its own lazy chunk so it does not affect first paint. `exceptions` maps irregular inflected forms to their base (led -> lead), from WordNet's own *.exc files, so a bullet written in the past tense still finds synonyms.
